title: A CI job cut at its time cap with failures so far reads red, not only cancelled
why: Coordinator 19:48 CST Nov 9: in two batch-70 runs (#2470) the job cut at its time cap reported only "cancelled", which hid 126 failing waiting-page cases, so the batch read it as a cap problem (step shoot-job-cap).
note: Fix: a suite run under a cap prints its failure count so far (or runs with fail-fast reporting) before the cut, so a capped job with reds reads red. Related: shoot-job-cap, ci-guard-headroom, time-pinned-tests-go. Filed 19:42 CST Nov 9 from the coordinator.
